canonical_work.title: AdiBhashaa: A Community-Curated Benchmark for Machine Translation into Indian Tribal Languages

identity_verification.canonicalization_rule: Dataset card, repository files, and cited arXiv paper are manifestations/documentation of the same AdiBhashaa release and must not be counted as independent corroboration.

mundari_scope.scope_warning: The corpus is a machine-translation benchmark. Sentence pairs are not evidence for timeless ethnographic or cultural claims, and individual entries require provenance/context review before any cultural interpretation.

rights_access_consent.access_note: Provider page states that contact-information sharing/acceptance of conditions is required to access repository files/content.

exact_locator_candidates.locator: dataset card: Dataset summary / Repository layout
exact_locator_candidates.supported_metadata: 80,000 sentence overall benchmark; Mundari train file reported at approximately 20,150 pairs
native-speaking translators and independent validators are reported in the creation workflow

quality_and_uncertainty.iso_metadata_warning: Provider card reports Mundari ISO as 'unv'; this must be checked against authoritative ISO/Glottolog metadata before normalization because common Mundari identifiers elsewhere may differ.

promotion.reason: Metadata and documentation are sufficiently verified for source census, but gated corpus files were not inspected and proposition-level evidence has not been established.
